description: What SnapEX Pay charges, no key needed. pricing: invoice_fee_percent (of a paid invoice; fee_on=customer puts it on the payer), invoice_min_usd/invoice_max_usd, static_address_fee_percent, payout_service_fee_percent; the network fee of a payout depends on the coin and is quoted by preview_payout, the smallest payout per coin is payout_min_usd in list_assets. data: recent cached route fee quotes (often empty; filter by route and asset codes).
